Package org.uma.evolver.parameter

Class ConfigurationVariants

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.parameter.ConfigurationVariants
public final class ConfigurationVariants extends Object
Derives variants of a configuration by fixing some of its parameters, keeping the result valid for its parameter space: the tool of an ablation study, where a tuned configuration is compared with copies of itself in which a few components are set to other values (no external archive, the default crossover, ...).

Fixing a parameter can change which other parameters are active. Setting crossover from SBX to blxAlpha deactivates sbxDistributionIndex and activates blxAlphaCrossoverAlpha; setting algorithmResult to population deactivates the archive parameters. The variant has exactly the parameters that are active for its values, in the order of the parameter space: the value of each one is the one fixed, or else the one in the configuration, or else the one in a fallback configuration (usually the default configuration of the algorithm), which provides the parameters that the change activates. 


 var space = new YAMLParameterSpace("NSGAIIDouble.yaml", new DoubleParameterFactory());
 String withoutArchive =
     ConfigurationVariants.derive(space, tuned, Map.of("algorithmResult", "population"), defaults);

  • Method Details

    • derive

      public static String derive(ParameterSpace space, String configuration, Map<String,String> changes, String fallback)
      Derives a variant of a configuration.
      Parameters:
      space - the parameter space of the configuration
      configuration - the configuration, as --name value pairs
      changes - the parameters to fix, by name, and their values
      fallback - the configuration whose values are used for the parameters that become active and are neither in changes nor in configuration; may be empty
      Returns:
      the variant, as --name value pairs separated by spaces
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a parameter of changes is not in the space or is not active in the variant, if a value is not valid for its parameter, or if a parameter that becomes active has no value anywhere

    • parameterValues

      public static Map<String,String> parameterValues(String configuration)
      Splits a configuration into its --name value pairs.
      Parameters:
      configuration - a configuration, as --name value pairs; may be null or blank
      Returns:
      the value of each parameter, by name, in the order of the configuration
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the configuration is not a list of such pairs
